audit.whatIsWrong: packet defect: 'spikes[] has 3 entries, expected 4', and sequencingCues 0 — no cooldown numbers anywhere despite the entire page being built on 'punish the post-E window'.
audit.why: Ashen Pursuit is a FLAT 10s at every rank — that is the number the whole gameplan turns on and it never appears. His Q is 10s at rank 1 falling to 6s, Soul Ignition 18s, Purgatory 120/100/80s. The missing 4th spike is filled with the late-game consequence of that flat 10s.
audit.corrected: Numbers written into breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, dontsFull[1].d, tradeGood, breakdown.trading, report[5], whys[4] and phases[4].why; spikes[3].text and spikes[3].when created with before:null.

audit.whatIsWrong: Itemization said 'Anti-heal is optional — his sustain is self-refund, not lifesteal.'
audit.why: Grievous Wounds reduces healing from any source, and Soul Ignition's end-of-duration refund is healing. Calling anti-heal optional on the grounds that the healing is self-inflicted-damage recovery is a category error, and it is the one item choice that decides his 18s trade pattern.
audit.corrected: Replaced with Grievous Wounds cutting the 18s Soul Ignition refund, timed before his first item.

audit.why: The rest of the interaction set holds up: Purgatory's execute threshold, the Zhonya's/stopwatch answer (untargetable at the floor denies an execute), and Ashen Pursuit as both engage and only exit are all consistent with Riot's text. Silver Stake's on-hit (missingInteractions) is already covered by report[8]'s 'his damage is AP' note.
